BiblicalUsage: Rashash is to demolish, to break down. Jeremiah says the enemy 'shall eat up thy harvest, and thy bread... they shall impoverish thy fenced cities, wherein thou trustedst, with the sword'; and Malachi says of Edom, 'Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus saith the LORD of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down.'
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the demolishing is God's answer to rebuilding without Him: Edom says we will build, and the LORD says I will throw down — and the desolate places stay desolate.
